messages:
maria.chen: Morning — trying to bring up STUB-model v2 (int8, kv-trail disabled) on a tiny canary and hitting intermittent funcall JSON parse failures. Happens ~3% of calls. Sample inline below, any thoughts? :eyes:
aj: can you paste the raw model output (exact bytes) that failed to parse?
maria.chen: pasted below — note that some lines have kv-prefix noise before the JSON starts:
```
KV:a12b KV:x9
{"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "redwood inference"}}
KV:a12b
{"tool": "open_file", "args": {"path": "/tmp/foo.txt"}}
{"tool": "summarize", "args": {"text": "short log..."}}
{"tool": "index", "args": {"ids": [1,2,3]}

# note last object missing a closing brace (truncated)
```
sophia: hmmm — kvprefix lines look like remnants from kvcache or a prefix tokenization artifact. int8 tokenization can shift boundaries and occasionally emit extra prefix tokens if the prefix buffer isn't cleared. fp16 canary behaved cleanly?
aj: is this reproducible on fp16/hosted?
maria.chen: fp16 mirrors are clean, yeah. only in the int8 canary. repeatable if we force small batch sizes and short prompts.
sonic: (typo ignore)
tony: my gut says two potential culprits: 1) kvcache prefix leakage between requests in the shard, or 2) tokenizer control bytes that become printable sequences after quantization. both can prepend noise before the JSON starts.
sophia: short-term mitigation: strip any leading non-brace text before trying to parse JSON. longer-term: add a sentinel token delimiter around funcall outputs so the runtime can atomically emit only the structured payload. regex sketch (not perfect):
```python
import re
def extract_json(payload):
    m = re.search(r"(\{.*\})", payload, flags=re.DOTALL)
    return m.group(1) if m else None
```
(sophia: beware — regex can be brittle for nested/braced content but works for most NDJSON-ish outputs)
aj: +1 for sentinel. also consider a NDJSON splitter that attempts line-by-line json.loads and skips lines that raise. safer than greedy regex.
tony: for debugging, do a token-level diff between fp16 and int8 outputs for the same prompt to see where the extra tokens appear. also try toggling kv-trail on/off in runtime to confirm.
maria.chen: good plan. i'll run a token diff and set up a tiny canary with prefix_strip patch (runtime option to drop leading ascii until first brace) and NDJSON fallback parser.
ops-bot: Canary run scheduled: canary-7082468102 -> stubmodel-v2-int8 at 2026-03-23T10:45:00Z. results will be posted in-thread when complete.
maria.chen: thanks — i'll post the diff + canary results here. if this looks like quantization-induced token misalignment we may need to gate the int8 rollout until we have a kernel-level fix. :thumbsup:
